title: Fig Gets Up
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds j, v, w
note_for_grown_ups: A small story of trying twice — Fig's first attempt genuinely does not work, which makes the second try's success feel earned rather than automatic.

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting at the foot of a tall tree, looking up towards a nest high above.
Fig the caterpillar climbing onto a long trailing strand of web hanging down the tree trunk.

pages.text: The web did rip. Fig fell!
pages.illustration: The thin strand of web snapping, Fig the caterpillar tumbling down through the air.
Fig the caterpillar sitting on the ground again, looking up at the tree, disappointed.
Fig the caterpillar standing back up, determined, brushing himself off.
Fig the caterpillar climbing onto a sturdier strand of web higher up the tree trunk.
Fig the caterpillar climbing steadily and successfully up the strand towards the nest.

pages.text: Fig is up! Fig is not sad.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar settled happily at the top of the tree beside the nest, pleased with himself.
